  if (!m) return text;
  const fraction = m[4] || '';
  let cents = BigInt(m[3].replace(/,/g,'')) * 100n + BigInt((fraction+'00').slice(0,2));
  if ((fraction[2] || '0') >= '5') cents += 1n;
  let whole = (cents / 100n).toString();
  if(m[3].includes(',')) whole = whole.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g,',');
  return m[1]+m[2]+whole+'.'+(cents%100n).toString().padStart(2,'0')+(m[5]||'');
};
